name: brainmcp
description: Shared, reviewable project memory for coding agents: the brain MCP server, usage and setup skills, and orientation plus opt-in session-capture hooks.

interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the brain MCP server (graph memory where every write is a reviewable proposal), adds the using-brainmcp and setup skills, and installs SessionStart orientation plus opt-in session-capture hooks. Codex runs the hooks only after you trust them.
defaultPrompt: Use brain to give me an overview of this workspace.
